scenario.title: Database change rehearsal and release-fleet evidence
situations: Hosted user has only HTTPS control-plane access
Release ships migration or uncovered schema
Fleet copy busy or validation fails
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: No hosted-to-operator rehearsal handoff was live-tested.
Determine the external-project provisioning recipe for validation bindings; current help explicitly leaves other projects to hydrate their own binding.

lessons.title: A migration claim is item evidence
lessons.when: Idea/refinement/implementation finds a governed data-transforming change
lessons.need: Read databases operation home and amend the unified DB claim. Author permanent ordered history, compatibility evidence and rehearsal; boot applies merged history. Ordinary additive behavior depends on the project boot contract, not arbitrary manual SQL.
lessons.surface: Standing databases pointer; idea DB classification; databases deep home.
lessons.gap: First database-change teaching should route to both model setup and item claim, not assume a preconfigured model. Preserve the external-owner path.

lessons.title: Rehearsal requires two different authorities
lessons.when: Before first rehearsal, especially on Yoke Cloud
lessons.need: The item/lease/receipt belongs to its control plane; migration code runs on a separate validation DB. Current rehearse command requires local-Postgres/db-admin access to the item universe and refuses HTTPS. If unavailable, it directs the user to the control-plane operator.
lessons.surface: migration rehearse help; databases lines 15 and capability validation-binding reference.
lessons.gap: Major adoption boundary: hosted users cannot self-serve this with application DB credentials. Proposed discovery must disclose the limit before governance is accepted; the end-to-end external-user provisioning path remains to be designed/verified.

lessons.title: Model declaration does not complete release setup
lessons.when: A governed project approaches its first release
lessons.need: Each model also needs migration_fleet: named databases with project boot/verification commands, engine tenants only for that topology, or none with a reason. Project-admin declares it; release uses target-specific coverage. Item rehearsal and fleet receipts prove different things.
lessons.surface: Fleet reference lines 14–56 and 133–154; release refusal names declaration recipe.
lessons.gap: Verified gap: onboard declares migration_model but never migration_fleet; later release refuses missing fleet. Proposed release-readiness lesson must collect the real fleet/boot facts or explicit none before dispatch.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type migration_fleet --json

lessons.title: Recover without damaging live or validation state
lessons.when: Rehearsal, fleet copy or boot refuses
lessons.need: Follow named authority/identity/restore-point/ledger/fleet failures. Busy fleet copy is a wait with holder details; failed proof earns no receipt. Applied history is immutable, and item receipt cannot substitute for release fleet proof.
lessons.gap: A human troubleshooting front door should route failures by missing authority, missing declaration and failed proof; do not hide all behind generic database setup.
